test_title: PYST 41: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who knows all things
solution:
The correct answer is **"Omniscient"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options,** "Omniscient"** is the most appropriate one-word substitute.
 
• **Omniscient: **All-knowing person
 
 
• **Example: **I strongly believe that God is **omniscient.**
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 1)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options as well.

 
• **Omnipotent:** One with unrestricted authority or power
 
• **Oligarchy:** A small group of very powerful people that controls a government or society
 
• **Ostracise:** To intentionally avoid someone or discourage them from participating in group activities
